{{Top|leg}}
'''Trityn''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Trityn claimed the bounty on [[Morana Fal]]; while battling her, the bounty hunter deflected a [[conner net]] into the water and short-circuited Fal's armor.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
